preamble.summary: Isaiah 18 is the CUSH (ETHIOPIA) ORACLE — a brief 7-verse oracle addressed to-the-Nubian-Cushite-empire (then-controlling Egypt). The chapter is the OT's-most-direct address-to-sub-Saharan-Africa. Verse 7's vision-of-Cushites bringing-tribute to-Mount-Zion anticipates Acts 8:26–40's Ethiopian-eunuch conversion.
preamble.notable_variants: 18:1 'land of whirring wings' / Cush — sub-Saharan Africa; 18:2 'tall and smooth' Cushite-warriors description; 18:7 Cushite-tribute → Acts 8:26–40 Ethiopian-eunuch fulfillment.
preamble.structural_notes: MT Isaiah 18 = LXX Isaiah 18. 7 verses. CUSH (ETHIOPIA) ORACLE.

variant_notes: 'Ah, land of whirring wings that is beyond the rivers of Cush' tracks MT. CUSH (Nubia / Ethiopia) — beyond-the-rivers (Nile-tributaries). 'Whirring wings' may-refer to-locusts or to-sailboats with-shaped-sails on-the-Nile.

'Which sends ambassadors by the sea, in vessels of papyrus on the waters! Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people feared near and far, a nation mighty and conquering, whose land the rivers divide' tracks MT. PAPYRUS-VESSELS — Nile-reed-boats. 'Tall-and-smooth-skinned' — Cushite-physical-description.
'All you inhabitants of the world, you who dwell on the earth, when a signal is raised on the mountains, look! When a trumpet is blown, hear!' tracks MT.

'For thus the LORD said to me: I will quietly look from my dwelling like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest' tracks MT. DIVINE-QUIETLY-LOOKING — providential-pause-before-judgment.

'For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he cuts off the shoots with pruning hooks, and the spreading branches he lops off and clears away' tracks MT.

'They shall all of them be left to the birds of prey of the mountains and to the beasts of the earth. And the birds of prey will summer on them, and all the beasts of the earth will winter on them' tracks MT.

'At that time tribute will be brought to the LORD of hosts from a people tall and smooth, from a people feared near and far, a nation mighty and conquering, whose land the rivers divide, to Mount Zion, the place of the name of the LORD of hosts' tracks MT. CUSHITE-TRIBUTE-TO-ZION. Acts 8:26–40 (Philip-and-the-Ethiopian-eunuch) Christologically-fulfills — the first-recorded sub-Saharan-African convert. Psalm 68:31 ('Cush shall hasten to stretch out her hands to God') parallels. The Ethiopian-Orthodox-Church traces-its-foundation to-this fulfillment.
